articles.summary: Is it safe for babies to sleep on their stomach? Pediatricians recommend back sleeping for every sleep until age 1 to lower the risk of SIDS. Once your baby can roll both ways on their own, they can stay in the position they choose. Learn the AAP safe sleep guidelines, when stomach sleeping becomes safe, and how to set up a safe sleep space.
articles.title: Baby Sleeping on Stomach: Is It Safe? A Pediatrician Explains
